ExcelJS 4.4.0 (exceljs.min.js), MIT.
Self-hosted (same approach as SheetJS) -- used by shared/excel-export.js to
build styled .xlsx files in the browser (colours, merged title, frozen header,
filters). SheetJS Community Edition cannot style cells, which is why ExcelJS is
used for exports instead.
Obtained from npm package "exceljs@4.4.0" (dist/exceljs.min.js).
